title: Release of Sub-Sectoral Trial Index of Services Production (ISP) for July 2026 (Base Year 2024–25)
body_text:
The Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation (MoSPI) releases the Index of Services Production (ISP) for the month of July 2026 in respect of 19 sub-sectors, with base year 2024–25. Sub – Sector wise trends in ISPs in July, 2026 over July, 2025 are given below:
S. No. Broad Sub -Sector ISP July, 2026 Growth in July, 2026 over July, 2025 1 Wholesale Trade 126.8 12.1 2 Retail Trade 140.0 18.5 3 Repair Services 126.3 -5.0 4 Accommodation and food 144.0 12.6 5 Railway Transport 106.1 7.5 6 Road Transport 132.1 9.9 7 Water Transport 107.5 7.7 8 Air Transport 87.8 -8.4 9 Warehousing and support activities for transportation 127.8 9.8 10 Postal and Courier 107.4 8.7 11 Telecommunications 121.4 11.0 12 Information and Broadcasting 120.8 10.0 13 Banking 121.9 12.3 14 Insurance 124.1 8.9 15 Real Estate 121.2 14.4 16 IT and computer related services 119.1 10.7 17 Professional, scientific & technical services including R & D 116.2 10.4 18 Administrative and support services 134.5 20.9 19 Arts, Entertainment and Recreation Services 107.0 1.7
The month wise indices for the above sub-sectors from July 2025 are given in Annexure.
Notes:
The monthly ISPs are being published on an experimental basis. The publication of Trial Series would enable MoSPI to examine data quality, test its resilience and also receive feedback of stakeholders and users. The Indices of Railways, Banking and Insurance sub – sectors, are based on provisional monthly data and would undergo revision on an annual basis. This Press Release is also available at the Ministry’s Website - http://www.mospi.gov.in . The Data of ISP is also available at https://esankhyiki.mospi.gov.in
